$comment: Hand-curated. Attribute names TwinCAT accepts and real code uses, that appear on NO Beckhoff Infosys attribute page — so scripts/fetch-pragma-catalog.js can never produce them. Every entry is measured, not remembered: `archives` counts how many of 337 installed library archives (Beckhoff + CODESYS + project _Libraries, string tables read by libsymbols.js) contain the name; `sources` counts occurrences of {attribute '<name>'} across 299 real TwinCAT source files on the development machine. Measured 2026-08-05. Add to this file when a user reports a name the documented catalog does not know; drop nothing without re-measuring. Unknown names are NEVER an error - user-defined attributes are a supported TwinCAT feature and src/lsp/pragmas.js falls back to shape matching.

attributes.name: analysis
attributes.note: TE1200 Static Analysis: re-enables rules disabled further up. Documented under the Static Analysis product, not under PLC pragmas.

attributes.name: contains_no_copy
attributes.note: CODESYS compiler internal; marks a type whose instances must not be bitwise copied.

attributes.name: message_guid
attributes.note: Ties a compiler message to a GUID so the IDE can resolve it to a localized text.

attributes.name: no-analysis
attributes.note: TE1200 Static Analysis: suppresses rules for the following declaration or POU. Documented under the Static Analysis product, not under PLC pragmas.

attributes.name: object_name
attributes.note: Overrides the name an object is shown and generated under. Takes a value: {attribute 'object_name' := 'M_StateMachine'}. The single most-used undocumented attribute in real project code here.

attributes.name: old_input_assignments
attributes.note: CODESYS compatibility switch for pre-3.x input assignment semantics.

attributes.name: TcGenerated
attributes.note: Marks code emitted by a TwinCAT tool rather than written by hand. Present in 150 of 337 installed library archives - the clearest evidence that Infosys does not enumerate everything TwinCAT accepts.

attributes.name: vtable_order
attributes.note: CODESYS compiler internal; pins method dispatch-table order across online changes.
